name: @cognitum/cog-dev
description: Slash commands, skills, and subagents for the Cognitum cog dev/test/deploy/ops loop. Wires a Claude Code session to a seed's /mcp endpoint so cogs can be authored against live device state.

mcp.name: cognitum-seed
mcp.description: The seed's framework MCP surface (ADR-092). Tools cover cog management, sensor snapshots, RVF query, mesh status, identity. Resources expose the registry, witness chain head, ESP32 firmware metadata, per-cog manifests and recent logs.

seedUrl.description: Base URL of the seed. Defaults to USB gadget address; override for WiFi seeds.

bearerToken.description: Pairing bearer token (only required for paired writes; reads are public on USB).

autoDiscover.description: Probe USB / mDNS / configured WiFi IPs to find the seed automatically.
